description: A script for generating certificates and keystores for Hono, including creating keys, certificates, trust stores, and client certificates.

methods.name: create_key
methods.description: Generates an EC or RSA private key based on KEY_ALG.

methods.name: create_cert
methods.description: Creates a key and certificate, signs with CA, and optionally exports to a keystore.

methods.name: create_client_cert
methods.description: Creates a client device key and certificate, signs with CA, and records the subject.
